name: Financial Instrument 55
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, dividend option or valuation currency.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the security by an ISIN.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial instrument in free format text.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Financial Instrument Short Name (FISN) expressed in conformance with the ISO 18774 standard.

SupplementaryIdentification.name: Supplementary Identification
SupplementaryIdentification.definition: Additional information about the financial instrument to help identify the instrument.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by the fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, for example, front end or back end, an income policy, for example, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, for example, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, for example, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Form, that is, ownership, of the security, for example, registered or bearer.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to the class type, that is, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

ProductGroup.name: Product Group
ProductGroup.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

IdentificationGuideline.definition: It is recommended that ISIN is used in Identification.|When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.
